findings_verbatim.finding: 2015 reports a treatment-by-time secondary isokinetic quadriceps-strength positive (P<.05), supported by the native bracket rather than inferred from within-arm stars. 2021 reports secondary bilateral isometric-force P=.158, despite both arms improving. Primary FFM is distinct in both studies; nominal multiple testing and absent treatment-effect CIs remain explicit. Non-significance is not equivalence, and Nm is not quantitatively pooled with N.

locators: 2015 native page1237 abstract, page1240 Table2/Results, page1242 Figures4–5
findings_verbatim.finding: The abstract reports 16.5 versus7.3 Nm changes with SD12.9/13.2, while Results prints16.12 versus7.38 and calls those dispersions SEM; figure captions also say SEM. Table2 labels an Nm strength measure Power. Placebo strength within-arm stars conflict with the broad Results wording; placebo Figure4 says n26 versus27 completers; motor-control cm versus mm is unresolved. These are retained, not silently repaired or used to create a new corrected significance claim.

2015 older independently living non-frail sarcopenic men:60 randomized,30/arm,26/27 analyzed, no ITT. 2021 overweight sedentary middle-aged men:120 randomized,40/arm,30/31/36 PP; main61 and exploratory97 remain distinct. The 2021 unsupported ITT-confirmation sentence is not independently auditable. Training/adherence exclusion thresholds, absent achieved adherence detail, and PP-limited safety claims are retained without all-randomized or pediatric/MVA safety inference.

findings_verbatim.topic: Preparation, protein/energy control and exploratory whey
locators: 2021 XML Investigational products/Dietary intake and native TableS1
findings_verbatim.finding: Both trials administer15g/day of the named collagen preparation during supervised training. The2015 type-I origin and approximate3kDa mean are source-specific; no species/lot/peptide-sequence or measured tissue exposure is established. Silica controls do not match protein/energy;2015 placebo gram amount is unreported,2021 all sachets15g and authors describe60kcal protein addition. Amino-acid profiles match where reported, but do not verify batch or retail equivalence. The15g Volactive90% powder is not an assayed15g pure-protein dose; whey contrasts are exploratory and non-significant, without superiority/equivalence or synergy.

Force changes163±189 versus100±154N, P=.158, primary FFM +3.42±2.54 versus+1.83±2.09kg, P=.010, fat-mass P=.023, and exploratory force P=.444 match the source. Figure95% intervals are arm-change intervals, not a treatment-effect CI. Table4 whey n31 differs from outcome n36; reported diet excludes test products and energy/carbohydrate differences remain. Formula-estimated muscle mass is not direct biopsy/MRI, and the verbal FFM subtraction-direction defect is preserved.

findings_verbatim.finding: 2021 registry explicitly labels retrospective registration (2015-09-01 after2014-11-01 start). Current eligibility, unreported arm/metabolic outcomes and ethics date differ from the main in stated ways; prior-version field contents are unverified and no outcome-switching/misconduct inference follows.2015 registration is unverified rather than asserted absent. Shared investigators, institution and manufacturer support prevent an independent-laboratory replication claim.

Correction adds Gelita sample provision and participant-compensation/sample-analysis costs, and Oesser patent co-inventorship for a2013-05-13 application with no exploitation remuneration. It changes disclosure, not endpoints, dispersion labels, statistics or strength data, and is not a retraction. The2015 original no-conflict statement is not used in place of the corrected disclosure.

The letter questions large FFM/fat-loss effects and leucine/arginine/creatine mechanisms, and asks what tissue DXA FFM represents. It has no torque reanalysis or replacement strength estimate. Its quoted numeric/arginine figures remain letter claims, and cited comparator studies are not requalified. The letter authors’ disclosed dairy/beef/egg/Pepsico/Nutricia interests are retained without using conflicts to dismiss the criticism. No formal reply was recovered; the2021 discussion is not established as such a reply.
